PART 5

Amendment of other acts

Amendment of Schedule 3 to Redundancy Payments Act 1967

32. The Redundancy Payments Act 1967 is amended in Schedule 3—

(a) by the substitution of the following for paragraph 5(c)(ii):

“(ii) while on parental leave, force majeure leave, leave for medical care purposes, domestic violence leave or on a flexible working arrangement under the Parental Leave Act 1998 , or”,

and

(b) by the substitution of the following for paragraph 8A(b)(ii):

“(ii) while on parental leave, force majeure leave, leave for medical care purposes, domestic violence leave or on a flexible working arrangement under the Parental Leave Act 1998 , or”.
